component.name: BreadSched
component.summary: Plan household cash flow from dated financial events

description.p: BreadSched is a household-finance application for tracking income and expenses, planning cash flow from dated financial events, and projecting household finances under saved assumptions and alternate scenarios.

ul.li: Double-entry registers, reconciliation, and scheduled transactions
An event-driven Plan with commitments, estimates, and actual-versus-plan review
GnuCash, QIF, and OFX import, with books stored locally in SQLite

description.p: BreadSched is alpha software. Keep independent backups of real books.
